author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenge.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.

output.content: I need to be explicit about the validation of the incoming scan lines. We will not proceed with any run where there is no validation step in place before the data moves on. This is a hard line for compliance. If the validation step is missing, meaning bad rows can reach the forecast without anyone or anything checking them, I will block the release. There is no middle ground here. We cannot have unchecked data in a system that handles personal data and drives financial commitments. A step that is in place and checks every load is the minimum, or the pipeline stays offline for us.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a non-negotiable condition (formal sign-off and complete governance) whose violation results in a refusal to proceed or release, establishing a hard limit rather than a preference or trade-off.
